newsitem.title: USA: Old Republic Q4 net down on investment drop.
newsitem.headline: Old Republic Q4 net down on investment drop.

text.p: Old Republic International Corp said on Wednesday that net income in the fourth quarter ended December 31 fell 11.4 percent primarily because of lower realized gains for its investment portfolio.

The company said it posted a pretax gain on its investments of $1.7 million in the fourth quarter of 1996 compared to a gain of $23.8 million in the corresponding period in 1995. Net income in the latest quarter was $62.5 million versus $70.6 million one year ago.
Old Republic said operating income totaled $61.4 million, up from $55.2 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Old Republic is an insurance holding company. Its shares were trading up 1/8 Wednesday at 26-1/2.
